title: UnitConfig
description: One unit file, content/units/<kind-in-kebab-case>.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §7, §7a). Fields land with the code that reads them (Q-CFG-10): NX-367 ships the identity fields, NX-121 speed_mps, NX-368 min_speed_mps and fuel_s, NX-150 sensor (with passive_range_m) and stealth; other stats, cargo and display join with later items. The loader (NX-367) checks what the schema cannot: the file name, min_rank iff VIEWER, min_speed_mps and fuel_s iff AIR with min_speed_mps <= speed_mps, weapon references, the kind set and the role map.

schema_version.description: File format version, unitless; the loader accepts only 1 (§4.4).

side.description: BASE = a facility, whose side follows its base (Q-GP-25). Friend/foe colors come from the side at runtime, never from the catalog (OV-2).

playable_by.description: Who may control this kind; no duplicates (loader).

min_rank.description: Rank needed to join as this kind (PROGRESSION §3), unitless. Present if and only if VIEWER is in playable_by (loader).

speed_mps.description: Cruise speed, unit m/s of world time (CFG-9, SIM-CORE SC-2); a ground unit moves at speed_mps x the edge's speed_mult (GAMEPLAY §5). 0 = does not move (STATIC).

min_speed_mps.description: Stall speed, unit m/s of world time: an airborne aircraft never flies slower and orbits at this speed when idle (GAMEPLAY §5, NX-368). Present if and only if domain is AIR, at most speed_mps (loader).

fuel_s.description: Endurance, unit s of world time airborne (CFG-9, NX-368); bingo fuel and RTB follow from it (STATE-MACHINES §4.1). Present if and only if domain is AIR (loader).

sensor.description: Active sensor (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 2, NX-150) and optional passive sensor (FOW-13).

radius_m.description: Detection range, unit m: an enemy inside radius_m x the target's stealth is tracked (Q-FOW-2); one range for all targets in the first build. 0 = no sensor.

passive_range_m.description: Passive sensor range, unit m: an emitting enemy site within it is discovered (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-11, FOW-13). Absent = no passive sensor (recon units and radar sites have one in the first build).

stealth.description: Multiplier on every enemy sensor's radius_m against this kind, unitless; 1.0 = no stealth (FOG-OF-WAR Tier 2, NX-150).

weapons.description: Weapon ids from content/weapons.yaml, no duplicates (loader); [] = unarmed.
